meta.sources_note: Expansion batch 12 (DECISIONS 034, continuous expansion per DECISIONS 027, no per-batch approval): 5 new models, 16 quotes. Meta Catalog CLI run 2026-11-06 (20 rows per model; raw files data/meta_catalog_raw_{apple-magic-keyboard,sony-wf-c710n,sony-linkbuds-open,logitech-pro-x-tkl,keychron-q1}_2026-11-06.json, gitignored). Brand-direct / retailer prices verified read-only 2026-11-06 ~18:33-18:50 UTC (10:33-10:50 PT): no sign-in, no cart, no purchase. CORRECTIONS vs the 2026-10-31 candidate notes: (1) The Magic Keyboard candidate range $99-$199 spans three different models — $99 is the plain Magic Keyboard, $129 the Numeric-Keypad-only Lightning model; the pinned Touch ID + Numeric Keypad USB-C White (MJM64LL/A) is $179 at Apple direct ($179.99 at Best Buy), and the Black Keys MJM74LL/A is $199, a different colorway. The 2026 MJM64LL/A supersedes the older MXK73LL/A (Adorama, on backorder to 01/2027). (2) The WF-C710N candidate price $129.99 is the list price (Sony US store) — the current street/sale price is $98 at Best Buy, Abt, Crutchfield and Beach Camera. (3) The LinkBuds Open candidate price $229.99 is confirmed current at Sony direct and Dell. (4) The PRO X TKL candidate price $219.99 is confirmed as the current list (launch SRP was $199); the Logitech G direct US price was not confirmed in page text. (5) The Keychron Q1 candidate range $229.99-$254.99 was the Q-line range (the Q1 Max is $229.99), not the base Q1 — the base Q1 V2 fully assembled knob lists $189.99 and is currently $89.99 on sale at Keychron direct. Three identifier sets stay pending (UPC/EAN single-source only): Magic Keyboard UPC 195951258324 (Apple US store page only), PRO X TKL UPC 097855188984 (eBay product identifiers only), Q1-O1Z EAN 4895248817345 (Keychron product JSON only) — all recorded in the catalog notes for re-check, never asserted as verified. Two direct prices are price-only (stock not confirmed in the page text): Lenovo US PRO X TKL Black $219.99 ('Available Soon') and the Sony direct WF-C710N Black price, which was not freshly confirmed at all (stale Black page at the $119.99 launch price; White page shows a $99.99 sale) and is not quoted here. Excluded as captured: marketplace/third-party rows (DECISIONS 021) — Target PRO X TKL $202.99 (sold by antonline), FlexShopper LinkBuds Open $199.99 (marketplace), Macy's WF-C710N $98.00 (shipped/sold by Focus Camera via Macy's storefront); non-US rows — WF-C710N iCuracao $124.99/$129.99, Ayoub $88, TechStop $139.90, LinkBuds Open iCuracao $229.99/$228, andreselectronicexperts $29,999 (garbage); bundles — WF-C710N + warranty $192.93, WF-C710N + case bundle $128, LinkBuds Open Macy's bundle $228, Beach Camera LinkBuds Open $239.99 (above list, warranty bundle); different variants — Magic Keyboard Black Keys MJM74LL/A ($199), plain Magic Keyboard $99, iPad Magic Keyboards ($269/$319), WF-C710N White/Glass Blue/Pink, LinkBuds Open White, LinkBuds Clip rows (different model), PRO X TKL White 920-012143 ($151.99 sale) / Magenta 920-012154 ($189.99 sale), PRO X TKL Linear Black 920-012122, PRO X TKL RAPID rows (different wired Hall-Effect model), PRO X 60 rows (different 60% model), Q1 Pro/Max/HE/Ultra 8K rows and Q1 plates/keycap sets (accessories, not keyboards), Q1 barebone rows ($59.99-$85.99, different configurations); above-list rows — PRO X TKL Newegg $299.99, Compsource Black 920-012118 $257.17 (OutOfStock; also a different/older Black listing); deal/clearance rows — Woot PRO X TKL Magenta open-box $109.99, Woot Q1 knob $79.99 (Blue switch, clearance), StackSocial LinkBuds Open open-box $89.99; below-list edu-store price — bkstr LinkBuds Open Black $199.99 (variant unconfirmed); the feed's Best Buy WF-C710N White $128 / Glass Blue $129.99 rows are different colorways and were not used for the Black price.
